orgs.name: FamilieSCN2A Foundation
orgs.snippet: Changes in the SCN2A gene can cause a range of health issues known as SCN2A-related disorders.

orgs.name: SCN2A Australia
orgs.snippet: SCN2A Australia began as a support network for families navigating SCN2A-related disorders, one of the genetic causes of developmental and epileptic encephalopathy.

orgs.name: The DRAGONFLY Study (NORD IAMRARE)
orgs.snippet: Welcome to The DRAGONFLY Study, a registry dedicated to individuals and families impacted by SCN2A-related disorders.

orgs.name: Simons Searchlight – SCN2A
orgs.snippet: SCN2A–related syndrome happens when there are changes in the SCN2A gene.

orgs.name: FamilieSCN2A Research Network
orgs.snippet: Professionals who are interested in sharing and learning more about SCN2A are invited to join the network.
